meta.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
meta.description:
Generate brand-quality product images through Higgsfield product-photoshoot
prompt enhancement on GPT Image 2 / gpt_image_2. Entry point for professional
brand/product visuals.
Use when: "product photo", "studio shot", "lifestyle image", "Pinterest pin",
"hero/banner", "carousel", "ad creative", "Meta ads", "virtual try-on",
"model wearing", "person holding product", "closeup with hands",
"levitating/floating/splash product", "CGI/surreal product", "restyle",
"seasonal/aesthetic variation", or any product, brand, or paid-social creative.
Modes: product_shot, lifestyle_scene, closeup_product_with_person,
moodboard_pin, hero_banner, social_carousel, ad_creative_pack,
virtual_model_tryout, conceptual_product, restyle. Backend assembles the final
prompt; never freehand it.
NOT for: no-product text-to-image (use higgsfield-generate), branded avatar
video (use higgsfield-generate Marketing Studio), marketplace listing cards
(use higgsfield-marketplace-cards), Soul Character training (use
higgsfield-soul-id).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成品牌级产品图片，用于广告和社交媒体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为品牌或电商生成高质量产品视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate brand-quality product images for ads and social media
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality product visuals for your brand or ecommerce

howto.what: 当你要做产品图片时，Claude会通过Higgsfield命令行生成品牌产品图：先问几个选择题（数量、风格、用途），再自动匹配模式（影棚、生活方式、广告等），后台组合提示词调用GPT Image 2生成，最后只返回图片链接。
howto.when: 当你说出「product photo」「studio shot」「ad creative」等关键词，或上传产品图要求生成/改版时触发。

say.text: 用这张水瓶图生成3张生活方式照片
say.note: 会按生活方式场景模式生成3张不同风格的图片链接。

say.text: 把这张图改成安静奢华风圣诞版
say.note: 触发restyle，保留主体只换氛围季节。

say.text: 为我的蜡烛品牌做一套Pinterest竖版pin

howto.what_en: When you need product images, Claude uses the Higgsfield CLI to generate brand-quality photos: it asks a few multiple-choice questions (count, style, use), picks the matching mode (studio, lifestyle, ad, etc.), lets the backend assemble the prompt and call GPT Image 2, then returns only image URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "product photo", "studio shot", or "ad creative", or upload a product image for generation/restyle.

say_en.text: Make 3 lifestyle shots from this water bottle photo.
say_en.note: Creates 3 lifestyle-scene images with different looks.

say_en.text: Restyle this image into a quiet-luxury Christmas version.
say_en.note: Keeps the subject, changes mood and season.

say_en.text: Create a Pinterest moodboard pin for my candle brand.
